userText: Next week I will visit my grandparents in the countryside. I look forward to it very much, because I have not seen them for a long time. We will cook together and walk in the fields. I think it will be a warm and happy weekend.
aiRevision: Next week I’ll visit my grandparents in the countryside. I’m really looking forward to it because I haven’t seen them for a long time. We’ll cook together and walk in the fields. It will be a warm and happy weekend.
errorSentences: 未使用目标词 'free expression'；整段虽语法正确、内容自然，但属于描述性记叙，未体现‘自由表达’（如个人观点、情感、想象、创意等主观性表达）；词汇基本为A1核心词，但缺乏A1水平允许的简单情感/意愿表达词（如 'I feel happy', 'I want to...', 'I like...' 等），略显单向陈述；'I think it will be...' 属于合理推测，但可更直接表达感受以增强表达自由度
suggestions: A1学习者可通过加入简单第一人称感受句（如 'I feel excited!', 'I love cooking with them.'）来体现自由表达。不必复杂，但需展现个人声音——这是free expression的核心。当前句子安全准确，建议下次尝试加1–2句带'I feel / I like / I want'的句子。
